content: Root cause: The bug occurred because the TLS 1.3 implementation was incorrectly using the last entry of a scatter-gather (SG) array, which was a circular buffer, to store a content type, leading to an overwrite of the first entry when the buffer was full. This caused memory corruption and crashes. The fix involved reserving an additional entry in the SG array to prevent the write from overwriting existing data, ensuring that TLS 1.3 could always use an unused entry even when the buffer was full.
